entities.name: Antonio Pacheco Massó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio Pacheco Massó is a retired Cuban baseball player. He played most of his career as a second baseman with the Santiago de Cuba of the Cuban National Series, and was a frequent member of the Cuba national baseball team, as a 3 times Olympic medalist. Pacheco has been a baseball instructor in the New York Yankees farm system since 2014.
